name: Kansas City
living: the fountain jets beyond the wall rise and fall in a slow rhythm, their spray shimmering (sprite + mask)
the waterfalls cascade with a soft scrolling shimmer and a faint mist at their base
the gold crown on the scoreboard catches a slow travelling glint
the crown scoreboard's LONGEST / TOTAL numbers tick over after each home run
downtown skyscraper windows flicker on one by one as the sunset deepens
the teal-lit spire on the tallest tower pulses softly, a red aircraft light blinking above it
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe, moths drifting through their cones
the orange sunset clouds drift slowly across the sky
the red-white-blue bunting on the wall ripples in the breeze
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
